_comment: PROPOSAL ONLY (Frontier, 2026-11-26; the owner decides, P-F1/P-F2 in QUESTIONS.md). Install it as .claude/settings.local.json in the integrator's clone $IMSRG_WORK/main (gitignored), without this _comment key; Claude never edits that file itself. The hooks (WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove for the per-agent clones, the PreToolUse guard tools/hooks/agent_guard.py) live in the committed .claude/settings.json and need no entry here. Compaction (D31) unchanged: agent frontmatter sets autoCompactWindow (600000 Sonnet/Haiku, 800000 imsrg-lead), the top-level value below covers the main session; never set CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE or CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW. Changes against the Mac version: Homebrew rules removed; `git push origin *` and `git fetch *` allowed (agents push their feature branch to the hub; the hub's update hook and agent_guard.py reject develop/main and other remotes), Slurm commands for builds on the compute node allowed, `git push github *` stays a prompt for the integrator; force pushes, branch deletion on remotes, remote changes, the shared stash and history- or file-destroying commands stay denied. Allow rules are a convenience, not a security boundary: the git hooks and agent_guard.py are the enforcement.
